justifications.text: Ticks a Sortie stage, an Archon Hunt stage or a Netracell when the player finishes such a mission with success, so that the list stays current without a click.
Shows the Sortie and Archon Hunt missions, the Circuit's rewards of the week, Nightwave's challenges, Baro Ki'Teer's visit and when each list resets, even with the game closed.
Keeps what the player ticked this day and this week, with when and how (by a mission or by hand), so that the list survives a restart and resets only at Warframe's resets.
